details:
In this feedback, i talk about some of my feature requests and upgrades to your VRChat platform

1 - Enstars-like menus

In the current VRC menu, it looks so VRC-ish themed.

Now, this proof-of-concept is a More Enstars-like menu for VRChat

This includes some UI elements from the ES2 10th anniversary. And even the sounds are the same as ES2.

I call this the Quick Menu 2.5ES and the Main Menu 3.0ES

2 - View Avatar Details:

Do you remember that the View avatar details on the old quick menu is so boring?

This version right here sees all 3.

First - Show Impostor avis means that when you select the full avi, it will show full avatar details of the user chosen's avi.

Next up - Show Hidden Details - Same thing, but it brings you to show the user's avi details

And lastly - View Fallback details - Similar to Quick menu, this brings to show a full fallback, not a user-selected avi.

3 - In-game news:

No NEED to join an official Discord, you have an in-game patch note with help and info on the main menus.

There are two tabs: Info and Issues

The Info tab is likely where the update patch notes, in-game news, and announcements are.

The Issue tab is mainly for your platform and has an issue that needs to be fixed in later updates.
title: VRC Feature Requests/Upgrades (April 30th, 2025) - Enstars UI/UX menus, user improvements and more
